newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ciampi repeats committment to EMU start.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi repeats committment to EMU start.

text.p: Italy's Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi on Wednesday re-stated a commitment to respect the "criteria and calendar" for European Monetary Union (EMU).
A treasury statement said Ciampi restated Italy's commitment during a meeting with leaders of Germany's employers organisation, headed by Hans-Olaf Henkel.

"(Ciampi told them) that the process of putting Italy's public accounts in order would continue along the path already laid out, which will lead to meeting the criteria for Maastricht," the statement said.
"Ciampi repeated everyone's commitment to respect the criteria and the calendar foressen by the Maastricht treaty," the statement said.
